facts.text: Mystique is carved into the Caldera cliffs of Oia on Santorini and overlooks the Aegean Sea.
facts.excerpt: Carved into the rugged Caldera cliffs of Oia in Santorini, Mystique overlooks the turquoise expanse of the Aegean Sea that encircles the island of Santorini.

facts.text: Set on the lower side of the Caldera, the hotel has unobstructed views of the Aegean Sea and the volcano from every spot, including the restaurants, bars, spa and fitness center.
facts.excerpt: on the lower side of the Caldera offers unobstructed, infinity views to the Aegean Sea and the volcano, that are enjoyed from every spot of the hotel, including all restaurants and bars, the spa and fitness center among others.

facts.text: The hotel sits at the entrance of the village of Oia.
facts.excerpt: Perched at the entrance of the village of Oia with stunning caldera views

facts.text: Shops, bars and viewpoints are within easy walking distance of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: From Mystique; shops, bars, and viewpoints are all within easy walking distance.

facts.text: The design follows Cycladic architecture, with gentle curves and sculpted arches, a muted color palette and light-filled spaces.
facts.excerpt: The design follows the emblematic Cycladic architecture, where gentle curves and sculpted arches blend with a muted color palette and light enhancing spaces.

facts.text: Kalia and Antonis Eliopoulos opened Mystique in Oia in 2007.
facts.excerpt: Their passion for hospitality motivated them to take on the iconic Oía village, where they introduced in 2007 Mystique

facts.text: Mystique is owned and operated by Empiria Group.
facts.excerpt: Owned and operated by Empiria Group

facts.text: All the stone-crafted, cave-style suites and villas have secluded terraces looking out to the Aegean Sea and the volcano.
facts.excerpt: All of the stone-crafted, cave-style suites and villas boast secluded terraces that peer out onto the deep blue Aegean Sea and the quietly active volcano.

facts.text: Many suite and villa terraces have outdoor jacuzzis or private pools.
facts.excerpt: All suites and villas open onto private terraces, many featuring outdoor jacuzzis or private pools.

facts.text: Suites feature driftwood, linen textiles and carved patterns on the walls.
facts.excerpt: all suites are a wondrous exploration of free-spirited driftwood, linen textiles, and intriguing carved patterns on the walls.

facts.text: The Holistic Villa is at the highest point of Mystique, with a living and dining area and two bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms and rain showers.
facts.excerpt: Majestic villa located at the highest point of Mystique, with airy living and dining area, two bedrooms with the Luxury Collection beds and en-suite bathrooms with rain showers.

facts.text: The Holistic Villa terrace has a hydromassage infinity pool, an outdoor jacuzzi, sunbeds and an open-air dining area with Caldera views.
facts.excerpt: Its vast terrace with hydromassage infinity pool, outdoor jacuzzi, sunbeds and open-air dining area offers captivating views to the Caldera.

facts.text: The Secrecy Villa has a sprawling terrace and plunge pool in a more hidden-away spot on the property.
facts.excerpt: The Secrecy Villa, for example, is perfect for honeymooners with its sprawling terrace and plunge pool, but its more hidden-away location on the property offers more privacy.

facts.text: Interior details include upcycled olive pits repurposed into table tops.
facts.excerpt: added quirky details, like the upcycled olive pits repurposed into table tops.

facts.text: In 2024 the suites and villas were fully renovated.
facts.excerpt: In 2024, Mystique unveiled fully renovated suites and villas.

facts.text: The hotel has two pools, one of which is infinity-edge.
facts.excerpt: Santorini’s alluring beauty is highlighted at the hotel's two pools, one of which is infinity-edge.

facts.text: The pools sit on the volcanic cliff with views of the Caldera and the volcano.
facts.excerpt: Perched on the volcanic cliff above the Azul blue Aegean Sea, Mystique’s pools offer captivating views to the Caldera and the volcano.

facts.text: Elios Spa is set in a space built in traditional Cycladic cave-style architecture.
facts.excerpt: Nestled in a space embracing the traditional cycladic cave-style architecture, a haven of peace and tranquillity unfolds

facts.text: Elios Spa signature treatments use organic, regionally derived ingredients.
facts.excerpt: Organic and regionally derived, the therapeutic ingredients used in the hotel’s Elios Spa provide signature treatments for whole body relaxation rituals.

facts.text: Elios Spa has two treatment rooms, one of them for couples.
facts.excerpt: Elios Spa is a cozy operation of just two treatment rooms (one of which is for couples).

facts.text: Spa services include the After Sun Cure, an aloe serum treatment that finishes with a scalp massage.
facts.excerpt: There are also more unusual services, such as the After Sun Cure, which will slather you in an aloe serum before it finishes with a relaxing scalp massage.

facts.text: The gym has Technogym equipment and views to the Aegean Sea.
facts.excerpt: Mystique's gym features state-of-the-art Technogym equipment and captivating views to the Aegean sea

facts.text: A sunset wine ceremony is held in a 150-year-old wine cellar.
facts.excerpt: The old setting of the 150-year-old dramatic wine cellar serves as delightful backdrop for our sunset wine ceremony.

facts.text: The tasting in the Secret Wine Cave features 7 indigenous wines.
facts.excerpt: The unforgettable tasting of 7 exquisite indigenous wines in our Secret Wine Cave will evoke the spirit of Santorini

facts.text: Lure, perched above the Caldera, is led by Chef Yiannis Kioroglou with a Mediterranean menu guided by simplicity and seasonality.
facts.excerpt: Perched above the Santorini Caldera, Lure is led by Chef Yiannis Kioroglou, the menu expresses a Mediterranean identity, guided by simplicity and seasonality.

facts.text: Most vegetables and herbs used in the restaurants are grown on the hotel's organic farm in the village of Megalohori.
facts.excerpt: Most of the vegetables and herbs used to prepare the refined dishes at Mystique’s restaurants, are cultivated in the hotel’s organic farm in the village of Megalohori.

facts.text: Captain's Lounge occupies the original site of a century-old mansion and offers all-day casual dining.
facts.excerpt: Occupying the original site of a century-old mansion, Captain’s Lounge caters for all day casual dining.

facts.text: The Aegean Balcony, on a secluded terrace at the edge of the Caldera, is used for private dining.
facts.excerpt: Perched on one of the secluded terraces at the edge of the Caldera, lend yourself to the ultimate Santorini dining experience under the starry night sky

facts.text: Circe Bar serves wellness-inspired low-proof cocktails, traditional Greek flavored drinks and nibbles.
facts.excerpt: It features wellness-inspired low-proof cocktails, traditional Greek flavored drinks and nibbles.

facts.text: The hotel only accepts guests who are 14 years old and over.
facts.excerpt: the hotel only accepts guests who are 14 years old and over.

facts.text: Guests walk down a series of steps to reach the hotel entrance.
facts.excerpt: You do need to walk down a series of steps to reach the entrance of the hotel.

facts.text: Travelers with mobility concerns may struggle, as staying on the caldera means constantly walking up and down stairs.
facts.excerpt: Travelers with mobility concerns may struggle with staying at a hotel in the caldera, where you are constantly walking up and down stairs.

facts.text: Terraces and outdoor jacuzzis may be visible from other parts of the hotel or from outside the property.
facts.excerpt: remember that someone might be able to see you from another part of the hotel or from outside the property altogether.

facts.text: Mystique is open seasonally, from mid-April to early November.
facts.excerpt: Mystique, for instance, is open from mid-April to early-November.

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as a favored destination for honeymoons and romantic escapes.
facts.excerpt: A favored destination for honeymoons and romantic escapes, Mystique emanates a carefree spirit

contradictions.note: p3 says three restaurants; p5 says two restaurants and two bars

sources.excerpt: three restaurants, each with its own individual character.
Mystique has a pretty comprehensive culinary program with two restaurants and two bars.
